## Chiron 0.2.2

The boot screen and opening UI now say **Chiron**, not Pegasus.

### What’s new

- Loading splash shows the Chiron centaur mark and name
- Window title is Chiron
- Exit / About / settings / empty-library messages use Chiron wording

### Download

`Chiron-0.2.2-x86_64.AppImage`

```sh
chmod +x Chiron-0.2.2-x86_64.AppImage
./Chiron-0.2.2-x86_64.AppImage
```
